lines.text: What if every light in New York switched off... for five seconds?
Times Square at night. Thousands of screens, and a sky so bright you can barely see a single *star*.
With every light off, the sky above New York is full of stars. Like *this*.
But you wouldn't see a single one.
Your eyes need *twenty to thirty minutes* to adapt to the dark. Five seconds isn't even close.
Follow for more. What should vanish next?
